Loading required libraries:
```{r}
library(lmerTest)       
library(lattice)     
library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(DHARMa)
```

parks type:
```{r}
urban_parks <- c("ADMIRALTY PK", "BUKIT BATOK NATURE PARK", "BUKIT BATOK TOWN PARK",
                 "MOUNT FABER PARK", "TAMPINES ECO GREEN PK")
buffer_parks <- c("CHESTNUT NATURE PARK", "RIFLE RANGE NATURE PARK", "WINDSOR NATURE PARK",
                  "THOMSON NATURE PARK", "DAIRY FARM NATURE PARK")
```

load data:
```{r}
parks <- read_csv("data/csv/parks_all_years.csv", col_names=TRUE) |>
    mutate(
    year_month = tsibble::make_yearmonth(year = year, month = month),
    time = as.numeric(year_month - min(year_month))
  ) 
wider_data_ndvi <- parks |>
    filter(variable != "ndmi")|>
    mutate(type = if_else(name %in% urban_parks, 1, 0)) %>%                
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(name, year, month, type, year_month),
        names_from = stats,
        values_from = value) |>
    mutate(across(c(name, type, year, month), \(x)as.factor(x))) |>
    select(name, month, year, year_month, type, mean_ndvi, cumulative_monthly_precip,mean_monthly_max_temp,mean_monthly_mean_temp, n_pixels) |>
    arrange(name, year_month) |>
    group_by(name) |>
    mutate(precip_lag1 = dplyr::lag(cumulative_monthly_precip, 1),
        precip_lag2 = dplyr::lag(cumulative_monthly_precip, 2),
        max_temp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_max_temp, 1),
        max_temp_lag2 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_max_temp, 2),
        mean_temp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_mean_temp, 1),
        mean_temp_lag2 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_mean_temp, 2)) |>
    filter(!is.na(mean_ndvi)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !mean_ndvi &!n_pixels, \(x) as.numeric(scale(x))))

wider_data_ndmi <- parks |>
    filter(variable != "ndvi")|>
    mutate(type = if_else(name %in% urban_parks, 1, 0)) %>%                
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(name, year, month, type, year_month),
        names_from = stats,
        values_from = value) |>
    mutate(across(c(name, type, year, month), \(x)as.factor(x))) |>
    select(name, month, year, type, year_month, mean_ndmi, cumulative_monthly_precip,mean_monthly_max_temp,mean_monthly_mean_temp,n_pixels) |>
    arrange(name, year_month) |>
    group_by(name) |>
    mutate(precip_lag1 = dplyr::lag(cumulative_monthly_precip, 1),
        precip_lag2 = dplyr::lag(cumulative_monthly_precip, 2),
        max_temp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_max_temp, 1),
        max_temp_lag2 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_max_temp, 2),
        mean_temp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_mean_temp, 1),
        mean_temp_lag2 = dplyr::lag(mean_monthly_mean_temp, 2)) |>
    filter(!is.na(mean_ndmi)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !mean_ndmi &!n_pixels, \(x) as.numeric(scale(x)))) 

ndvi_lme_data <- wider_data_ndvi |>
    drop_na(mean_ndvi, type, cumulative_monthly_precip, mean_monthly_max_temp, mean_monthly_mean_temp, precip_lag1, precip_lag2, max_temp_lag1, max_temp_lag2, mean_temp_lag1, mean_temp_lag2)

ndmi_lme_data <- wider_data_ndmi |>
    drop_na(mean_ndmi, type, cumulative_monthly_precip, mean_monthly_max_temp, mean_monthly_mean_temp, precip_lag1, precip_lag2, max_temp_lag1, max_temp_lag2, mean_temp_lag1, mean_temp_lag2)

```

plot plot plot 

```{r}
ggplot(data=wider_data_ndmi, aes())
```


use max temp for the lme:

```{r}
ndvi_lme <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ . - month - name -year - year_month - n_pixels  + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)

ndmi_lme <- lmer(mean_ndmi ~ . -month - name -year - year_month - n_pixels + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndmi_lme_data)
```

less lazy and add interaction terms:

```{r}
ndvi_lme_intx <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + cumulative_monthly_precip * mean_monthly_max_temp * mean_monthly_mean_temp * precip_lag1 * precip_lag2 * max_temp_lag1 * max_temp_lag2 * mean_temp_lag1 * mean_temp_lag2 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)
ndmi_lme_intx <- lmer(mean_ndmi ~ type + cumulative_monthly_precip * mean_monthly_max_temp * mean_monthly_mean_temp * precip_lag1 * precip_lag2 * max_temp_lag1 * max_temp_lag2 * mean_temp_lag1 * mean_temp_lag2 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndmi_lme_data)

summary(ndvi_lme_intx)
```

checking resids:

```{r}
plot(ndvi_lme) 
qqnorm(resid(ndvi_lme))
qqline(resid(ndvi_lme))
lattice::qqmath(ranef(ndvi_lme))                     
acf(resid(ndvi_lme)[order(ndvi_lme_data$name, ndvi_lme_data$year_month)]) 

```

what are the outliers at the bottom?

```{r}
ndvi_lme_data |>
    mutate(resid = resid(ndvi_lme)) |>
    arrange(resid) |>
    select(name, year_month, mean_ndvi, n_pixels, resid)

```

possible model:
```{r}
ndvi_good_model <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type*precip_lag1*mean_monthly_max_temp + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)

ndvi_final_model_with_lag <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + mean_monthly_max_temp + max_temp_lag2 + type:precip_lag1 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)

ndvi_final_model_no_lag <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + mean_monthly_max_temp + type:precip_lag1 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)

ndvi_final_model_no_temp <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + type:precip_lag1 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data)

AIC(ndvi_final_model_with_lag, ndvi_final_model_no_lag)
anova(ndvi_final_model_with_lag, ndvi_final_model_no_lag)
anova(ndvi_final_model_no_temp, ndvi_final_model_no_lag)
```

Another model
```{r}
ndvi_precip <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type * (cumulative_monthly_precip + precip_lag1 + precip_lag2) +
                      (1|month) + (1|name),
                    data = ndvi_lme_data, REML = FALSE)
final_model_ndvi <- lmerTest::step(ndvi_precip)
```

```{r}
ndvi_temp_precip <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type * (cumulative_monthly_precip + precip_lag1 + precip_lag2 + mean_monthly_max_temp + mean_monthly_mean_temp) +
                      (1|month) + (1|name),
                    data = ndvi_lme_data, REML = FALSE)
final_model_temp_ndvi <- lmerTest::step(ndvi_temp_precip)
```

no-lag comparison
```{r}
ndvi_no_lag <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type * (cumulative_monthly_precip + mean_monthly_max_temp + mean_monthly_mean_temp) +
                      (1|month) + (1|name),
                    data = ndvi_lme_data, REML = FALSE)
ndvi_no_lag_step <- lmerTest::step(ndvi_no_lag)
```

ML comparison for AIC
```{r}
no_temp_mod <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + (1 | month) + (1 | name), data=ndvi_lme_data, REML= FALSE)
temp_lag_mod <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + max_temp_lag2 + type:precip_lag1 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data, REML= FALSE)
temp_mod <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + mean_monthly_max_temp + type:precip_lag1 + (1|month) + (1|name), data=ndvi_lme_data, REML= FALSE)
final_model_ndvi <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + (1 | month) + (1 | name) + type:precip_lag1, data=ndvi_lme_data, REML=FALSE)
final_model_temp_ndvi <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + precip_lag1 + (1 | month) + (1 | name) + type:precip_lag1, data=ndvi_lme_data, REML=FALSE)
no_lag_mod <- lmer(mean_ndvi ~ type + (1 | month) + (1 | name), data=ndvi_lme_data, REML=FALSE)
AIC(no_temp_mod, temp_lag_mod, temp_mod,ndvi_precip,final_model_temp_ndvi,no_lag_mod)
```
